content: Churn drivers for retail bot users: backtest-to-live gap from overfitting (adding filters improves the curve but destroys transferability - a strategy that only works on one coin, one date range, one exact parameter set is fragile), unrealistic fill assumptions (perfect fills at requested price), far-too-short forward tests (3-day paper trade then live then -15%), and no post-deployment monitoring. A vendor blog claims 73% of automated crypto trading accounts fail within six months (LOW confidence, uncorroborated vendor stat - treat as directional only). Consistent theme across sources: users churn on the DISAPPOINTMENT gap, not on missing features.
